Subject: Request to pause scheduled purge — urgent forensics ask

Mateo,

We just got a legal preservation request related to a patient ingestion path investigated by our security team. Can Redwood pause the upcoming backup purge and log sweep for the affected tenant (arcadia-prod) so we can extract a targeted forensic bundle?

What we need: a 14-day pause on scheduled backup deletion for the specific tenant snapshot IDs you have for April 3–5, plus retention of the rolling KV/log window spanning seq 127800–128600 (approx). Arcadia legal will send a signed hold notice if required.

Attached is a short spec of the artifacts our forensics team needs (arcadia-evidence-specs.pdf). Two questions for you:
- Can you create an isolated, timeboxed export (read-only) containing the snapshots + KV logs and leave it on a secure transfer endpoint?
- If Redwood relies on a subprocessor (S3 vendor or backup vendor) for the snapshot copies, can you confirm whether they can also pause deletion for the same window?

We are on a tight cadence — please confirm by EOD so we can route an internal legal hold.

Thanks,
Evelyn Mason
Security & Privacy, Arcadia Health
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Mason <evelyn.mason@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to pause scheduled purge — urgent forensics ask

Evelyn — thank you, and sorry for the incident on your side. We can support two safe options depending on how long Arcadia expects the hold to run.

Option A — Short-term escrow export (recommended, < 30 days):
- We snapshot the requested snapshot IDs and export a read-only forensic bundle (snapshots + KV delta + tokenized metadata).
- Redwood will stage the export on a customer-specific, access-controlled SFTP endpoint for 14 days.
- This approach minimizes retention footprint and avoids changing global purge schedules.
- Subprocessor note: Our managed backup provider, GigaStore, supports a per-snapshot hold; we will request a conditional pause for the two snapshot IDs.

Option B — Staggered purge window (if hold > 30 days):
- Pause deletion for 'arcadia-prod' in our hot bucket for up to 90 days; cold-tier lifecycle still proceeds but we will keep an immutable forensic copy in escrow.
- Requires a DPA addendum (subprocessor attestation + fees) and an internal approval from Legal/Finance.

Practical constraints / asks from us:
- We need Arcadia legal to sign the hold notice and confirm the exact snapshot IDs and any IP ranges for the SFTP access.
- For Option B, we will need a DPA addendum signed before we extend any cold-tier retention changes (I attached a proposed addendum).
- Subprocessor confirmation: GigaStore and EdgeSync will be looped in; we can request the per-snapshot pause but cannot enforce their internal deletion if they have a conflicting legal hold — we'll need written confirmation from them, which takes ~48–72 hours.

Next steps I propose:
1) If you want Option A, reply with the exact snapshot IDs and we will provision the export and give you SFTP credentials within 24 hours.
2) If you anticipate >30d, flag that now so I can loop Legal (Kimberly) and jumpstart the DPA addendum.

I cc'd Kimberly and Marissa for legal/ops alignment.

— Mateo Alvarez
Data Protection & Compliance, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Thanks, Mateo and Evelyn. Quick legal note and redline suggestions: 

1) For Option A (export only) — we can provide the read-only export without DPA changes, provided Arcadia acknowledges the export is a copy for investigation and not a request to alter our standard retention schedule beyond the 14-day staging window. We will include an export access audit log and certificate.

2) For Option B (extend retention / pause purge into cold tier) — that is a material change. We need: 
- Signed addendum (coverage for subprocessor holds + fee schedule).
- Confirmation of who will bear the incremental storage/escrow cost if the hold extends beyond 30 days.
- A mutually agreed end date or event-based release criteria.

Please see my inline redlines in the attached proposed-dpa-addendum.docx. If Arcadia legal is OK with the addendum, we can expediate signatures via DocuSign and then send the hold request to GigaStore/EdgeSync. Note that subprocessor attestation turnaround is typically 48–72 hours.

Marissa — ops, please prepare a staging export checklist (paths, manifest, checksums, SFTP ACLs) and estimate the ops time (hours) to assemble the bundle. Jordan — please draft the outbound hold request to GigaStore with snapshot IDs so we can start parallel processing.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
